covers: The Zilog Z80 SCC serial communications controller family as a chip: one entry for every type that shares the z80scc register file

entries.name: Zilog Z80 SCC family
entries.description: Dual-channel serial controller with asynchronous, byte-synchronous and SDLC modes, programmed through a register file per channel; the family spans NMOS, CMOS, ESCC and EMSCC parts.
entries.behaviour: Each channel has write registers WR0 to WR15 and read registers RR0 to RR15. Universal-bus types (Z8530 family) reach them through a register pointer in WR0 and a control and a data port; Z-bus types (Z8030 family) address them directly. Asynchronous framing and the baud rate generator are modelled; SDLC, CRC, the DPLL and the status FIFO are not.

handlers.dc_ab_r: universal-bus read: offset bit 1 data or control, bit 0 channel A or B
handlers.dc_ab_w: universal-bus write: offset bit 1 data or control, bit 0 channel A or B
handlers.ab_dc_r: universal-bus read: offset bit 1 channel A or B, bit 0 data or control
handlers.ab_dc_w: universal-bus write: offset bit 1 channel A or B, bit 0 data or control
handlers.da_r: read the receive data of channel A
handlers.da_w: write the transmit data of channel A
handlers.db_r: read the receive data of channel B
handlers.db_w: write the transmit data of channel B
handlers.ca_r: read the control port of channel A (register by pointer)
handlers.ca_w: write the control port of channel A (register by pointer)
handlers.cb_r: read the control port of channel B (register by pointer)
handlers.cb_w: write the control port of channel B (register by pointer)
handlers.zbus_r: Z-bus read: the offset names channel and register directly
handlers.zbus_w: Z-bus write: the offset names channel and register directly
handlers.m1_r: interrupt acknowledge: returns the vector of the pending interrupt
handlers.ctsa_w: clear to send input, channel A
handlers.ctsb_w: clear to send input, channel B
handlers.dcda_w: data carrier detect input, channel A
handlers.dcdb_w: data carrier detect input, channel B
handlers.rxtxcb_w: one clock input for both receive and transmit, channel B
